purpose: Test existence of some crossing-free NG arrival order on bounded exact point sets; no universal or hardness claim.
bounds: All no-three-collinear subsets of the 3x3 grid of sizes 4..6, plus 30 seeded integer samples each of sizes 4..8 in [-20,20]^2, seed 140014; 1000 generation attempts/sample; lexicographic distance tie break.
stopping_rule: First set lacking an order, all planned sets completed, or 60 seconds checked after each set; a set uses exhaustive DFS with crossing pruning. Independent permutation enumeration for n<=6.
